verdict.rationale: Flagright's homepage claims in-product 'explainable AI agents' for AML operations and 'AI-native workflows' in case management. That implies AI-generated analysis of the customer's compliance data, but it is only a marketing one-liner with no documentation of what insights or suggestions are produced. The docs MCP server serves documentation, not insights from user data, so it is not credited. Missing for 10: documented description of the AI-generated insights or suggestions (e.g. alert or case recommendations, summaries), how they surface in the console, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
